feedback: Written before this candidate races, so no outcome is claimed for it. The candidate is identical to the iteration 5 design, the best raced design at score 160.41 (kp 2.5, ki 0.05, kd 0.3, base_speed 1.3, sensor_size 0.016, weights [2,1,0,-1,-2], line_loss search_right). It is valid and inside every contract limit. Your previous feedback on entity0 is stale: its ki 0.10 test was raced in iteration 8 and scored 109.75, with oval max_error rising from 0.0604 to 0.0616 and oval finishes falling from 3/20 to 0/20. Revert ki to 0.05 and make no further gain changes. Steering gain (kp 3.0, iteration 4: 83.5), kd (0.45, iteration 6: 143.1, oval oscillation 0.333), and line-loss direction (search_left in iteration 7 and search_right in iteration 5, both about 159 to 160) have all been tested and none improves on iteration 5. The remaining lever is geometry. Max_error has stayed at 0.060 to 0.062 m on every track since iteration 2, so the next single change should be sensor spacing, not controller tuning. Use the result to decide: if max_error stays at about 0.060 m and line_loss_events are unchanged, widen the outer sensors to x = plus or minus 0.020 m as the only change. If max_error falls and completion_time is above 3 s on the oval, test base_speed 1.5 instead, since iteration 5 oval finishes at 1.89 s show speed is adequate there.
